physical_condition.single_label_semantics: IHME GBD 2023 cause prevalences are overlapping marginals, while the profile schema stores one representative condition. Within each country-age-sex cell, child causes mapped to one schema label are summed first. The probability of at least one selected label is then approximated as 1-product(1-p_i), and that envelope is allocated in proportion to the mapped prevalence rates.
physical_condition.age_aggregation: IHME five-year age-specific rates are population-weighted with UN WPP 2025 sex-specific populations. Ages 18-24 use 2/5 of 15-19 plus all of 20-24; ages 65-80 use all of 65-79 plus 1/5 of 80-84.
